name: fade24
rule: fade a 24h move of >=1.5 sigma (z of 24h return vs 100h vol), 60% confidence, hold 24h
data: fade.db, 40 coins, 9,739 scored events over 1,036 days, cost 0.20% round trip, no funding
observation: net return per trade negative: day-cluster 95% CI [-0.701%, -0.069%], trimmed mean -0.113%, halves -0.438% / -0.317%, 10% of coins positive. Paired and shuffle tests passed (p=0.0094, 0.0005).
interpretation: Not supported as a profitable rule. The paired and shuffle tests were later shown to be anti-conservative with correlated coins (audit section 4) and were not relied on.

name: momentum ladder rungs 1-3

spec.decision: 00:00 UTC daily per coin; uses candles closing at or before that time
spec.signal: sign of previous 24h log return; zero return = no signal
spec.rung2: rung1 and vol_ratio>=1.25 (stdev 24h returns / stdev 720h returns)
spec.rung3: rung2 and agreement>=0.6 among coins with finite nonzero 24h return (target included), >=30 such coins
spec.trade: entry next candle open, exit close 24 candles later, 1x, no stops, equal size
spec.funding: NOT INCLUDED in this run (rung 4 and funding deferred; logged limitation)
spec.market_adjustment: net return minus signal sign x equal-weight mean gross return of coins with data over the same hold
spec.bootstrap: fixed non-overlapping 7-day blocks of days from day 31, 10000 resamples, 99.5% two-sided, seeds [101, 102]
spec.primary_gate: market-adjusted mean(rung3)-mean(rung2): 99.5% lower bound > 0 at seed 101; seed 102 must agree else UNSTABLE
spec.illiquid: 10 lowest mean quote volume (close x base volume) over the dataset
spec.family: 2 hypotheses (rung2 vs 1 descriptive, rung3 vs 2 gated), Bonferroni 1%

mechanisms.rung2: momentum continues when volatility is expanding
mechanisms.rung3: momentum is more reliable when other coins confirm it

observation: market-adjusted rung3 minus rung2 = -0.050% per trade, 99.5% interval [-0.152%, +0.053%] (seed 102: lower -0.158%); 5470 rung-3 and 6910 rung-2 trades, 152 weekly blocks
interpretation: The proposed mechanism (confirmation helps) was not supported at this sensitivity. Effects smaller than about +0.20% per trade could not have been detected, so this is not a disproof.
limitations: calibration used synthetic worlds with no persistent drift
rung 2 vs 1 not calibrated, descriptive only

name: carry v2.2 block-bootstrap calibration

supersedes.status: superseded before any calibration result or real return was seen; never claimed as passed

observation: Every world type and block length (14, 28, 56 days) exceeded the frozen false-positive limits; no block was selected; power was not run.
interpretation: Under the tested persistence assumptions the block-bootstrap intervals were far too narrow, because 4.7 years holds only a few independent funding regimes. The test design cannot support a significance claim. This is not evidence that carry does or does not work.
limitations: synthetic parameters were assumptions; real funding persistence may differ
no real funding rates or returns were read
v2.2 is not to be rerun or edited
